name: Whisper
summary: The open transcription model that became the default: robust multilingual speech-to-text you can run yourself.
description:
Whisper is the reason transcription stopped being a paid feature. It is robust across accents, handles code-switching and multiple languages, ships in several sizes, and the weights are open — so a pipeline can run on your own hardware with no per-minute invoice and no audio leaving the building. Most of the transcription products in this index are, at some layer, standing on it.

It is not a solved problem: it hallucinates on silence and music, timestamps need post-processing, and long-form accuracy drops on domain vocabulary nobody fine-tuned it for. If transcripts feed anything regulated, plan for a correction step and an evaluation set rather than trusting the raw output.
